how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four steps from request to confirmed group booking — no budget guessing, no email chains.
how.step1Body: Pick destination, dates, group size, hotel category and meal plan. No budget required — let hotels compete on price.
how.step2Body: Verified hotels in your destination submit competitive quotations within hours.

how.step4Body: Pick your preferred offer. The hotel and your agency continue the booking process directly.
